caption: The drawing features a single amber-colored glass pitcher positioned centrally against a neutral beige background. The pitcher has a rounded body with a narrow neck that flares out at the top to form a wide mouth and a small spout. The handle is attached from the rim to the upper part of the rounded body, arching gracefully. The base of the pitcher is decorative and slightly scalloped. The glass material is depicted with varying shades of brown and yellow, indicating transparency and reflective highlights. There are four rectangular beige marks, one near each corner of the composition, and the artist's name, "Beverly Chichester," is printed in small text near the bottom right corner. There are no additional objects or decorations in the image.
title: Pitcher
